### A Disobedient Prophet
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/disobedient-prophet
Passage: 1 Kings 13:33
Points:
- The man of God initially obeyed the Lord but allowed himself to be deceived by an older prophet's false claim of a new revelation.
- Being a recipient of divine revelation does not exempt anyone from judgment when disobeying God's direct command.
- God does not contradict Himself, meaning any alleged new message that violates His revealed word must be rejected.
- Christians must evaluate every teaching against the written Word of God rather than human claims of private revelation.
- In spite of dramatic prophetic signs and severe judgments, King Jeroboam persisted in his idolatrous worship.

### Lies and a Lion: Making Sense of 1 Kings 13
Author: Jeremy Kimble
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/lies-lion-kings/
Passage: 1 Kings 13:11-34
Points:
- The narrative warns believers that God demands wholehearted, precise obedience rather than partial compliance.
- Followers of God must not be swayed by supposed spiritual authorities who contradict what God has already spoken.
- God's word is entirely reliable, actively shaping events and carrying out both warnings and promises.
- Grasping difficult narratives requires reading them in light of the whole biblical storyline and God's sovereign covenant purposes.

### Lions and Levels of Narrative
Author: Kathleen Nielson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/lions-and-levels-of-narrative/
Passage: 1 Kings 13:26
Points:
- Believers need alert and enduring obedience, especially during vulnerable moments immediately following spiritual victories.
- The phrase "the word of the Lord" governs every turn of events, highlighting God's sovereign direction over human choices and nature.
- Both prophets erred by mishandling divine revelation—one substituting human words for God's, and the other falsely speaking in God's name.
- The failure of the Judean prophet highlights humanity's need for Jesus Christ, the true obedient Man from Judah who never fails.
